statement: AMD's GEAK-optimized MLA kernel on MI355 improved DeepSeek-V4 end-to-end throughput 2.10x and cut TTFT 3.71x, strengthening Instinct inference competitiveness.
why: Software gains make MI355 a more viable alternative to NVIDIA for inference, expanding supply options.

impact.mechanism: Better AMD inference performance increases alternative GPU supply and competition.

evidence.excerpt: the optimized MLA kernel improved E2E throughput by 2.10x and reduced TTFT by 3.71x
